scheme_name: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for the Wards of Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles
other_conditions: Applicants can be of any gender; marital status does not affect eligibility.
The scheme is limited to wards or widows of Central Armed Police Forces and Assam Rifles personnel (including serving, retired, ex‑service and those killed in action or receiving gallantry awards).
Only first professional degree courses such as BE/B.Tech, BDS, MBBS, B.Ed, BBA, BCA, B.Pharm, B.Sc (Nursing, Agriculture, etc.) are eligible.
Applicants must have a minimum of 60% marks in the Minimum Entry Qualification (10+2/Diploma/Graduation) for fresh admission, and at least 50% in each subsequent year for renewal.
Scholarship is limited to a maximum of two children per family.
Preference order among categories A to G is applied for fresh applicants.
A one‑year grace period is allowed for delayed renewal applications.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹3,000 per month for girls (₹36,000 per year) and ₹2,500 per month for boys (₹30,000 per year) for up to 5 years.
